meta.title: Anna K Wines — From Spanish vineyards to Nordic tables
meta.description: Anna K. connects Spanish wineries with the markets of northern and central Europe: export, representation and wine consultancy. Taster and wine judge.

hero.eyebrow: Wine consultant · Bridging Spain ⇄ Northern & Central Europe
hero.title:
From Spanish vineyards
to Nordic tables.
hero.sub: I'm Anna K. I connect Spanish wineries with the markets of northern and central Europe — export, representation and wine consultancy, done with judgement.

about.title:
I live wine
from vine to glass.
about.p1: For over two decades I've moved between vineyards, fairs and tasting rooms. I was raised between two worlds — the character of Spanish wine and the demands of the Nordic palate — and I've made that crossing my craft.
about.p2: I help Spanish wineries tell their story well and bring their wines to Sweden, Norway, Denmark and Finland: from the first contact with an importer to a place on the monopoly shelf.
about.p3: I taste, I teach and I judge. But above all I translate: I turn a winery's land and labour into a wine that a Northern table understands and desires.
about.quote: “Good wine needs no translation. Reaching the right table, though — that it does.”

bridge.title:
A bridge between
those who make the wine
and those who uncork it.
bridge.aside: I don't sell cases. I build long-term relationships between winery and market, and I look after every step of the way.

left.p: Families, high-altitude vineyards, appellations with history. Wine with soul that deserves to travel.

right.p: Importers, state monopolies, sommeliers and restaurants looking for something authentic.

services.title:
How I
work with you.
services.aside: Four ways to work together, depending on where you are on the road.

items.title: Export
items.desc: I open and manage sales channels across the Nordic countries — negotiating with importers and getting you onto state monopoly shelves.

items.title: Commercial representation
items.desc: I'm the eyes and voice of your winery in the North: fairs, visits, tastings and continuous customer follow-up.

items.title: Wine consultancy
items.desc: Positioning, portfolio, price and story. Together we decide which wines, for which market, with which narrative.

items.title: Tasting & training
items.desc: Guided tastings, team training and technical selection. A judge's palate at the service of your project.

certs.title:
Judgement,
accredited.
certs.aside: A selection of industry certifications and distinctions. (We'll swap this list for your real ones.)

judge.title: At the jury table.
judge.aside: I've judged at international competitions: tasting blind, scoring with rigour and defending a verdict. That same standard is what I bring to every winery.

stats.k: Years of experience in the trade

note.big: Northern and central Europe drink with curiosity and demand quality.
note.p: Most of my exports go to Poland, Germany and Finland, with a growing presence across the rest of Scandinavia. I know both open markets and the state monopolies: their processes, their timelines and their buyers.

testimonials.title:
What the
wineries say.
testimonials.aside: Long-term relationships, built bottle by bottle.

items.quote: “Anna didn't just open a market for us, she opened a culture. Today our wine is on tables across Stockholm.”
items.name: Inland winery

items.quote: “She understands wine like a taster and business like an exporter. That mix is incredibly rare.”
items.name: Nordic importer
